notes.title: Don't Miss Out! Adult VN Bullet Hell "Gremory" Smashes 200%+ Funding on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33076600/9663e8c42476e74829def13064e302d7b62cadcf.png[/img]
Hey everyone! Our succubus themed bullet hell visual novel [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mikandijapan/gremory-tale-of-the-god-slayer-adult-vn-bullethell?ref=6vqdo9][b]"Gremory" just crushed the 215% funded mark on Kickstarter[/b][/url]. What's more, all stretch goals have been unlocked so now is a great time to pledge. But time is running out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33076600/6ab81d08d8f3910e29edb3e079083078634f09e9.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33076600/cd5128491de2549c324caf609c71dd50cd51e03c.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33076600/1d9913feb3bb7fec079ace8f1ba6e01c2f518c5d.jpg[/img]
[i]
Gremory : Tale of the God Slayer[/i] is a story about the aeons old struggle between the gods of Asgard and the daemons, entities born of the primordial dark.

[b]Game Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Playable Demo
[*] Live 2D Sprites 
[*] Bullet Hell Minigame
[*] Original Soundtrack
[*] Amazing R-18 CGs
[*] 4-5 Hours of Gameplay
[*] Uncensored Ero Scenes
[*] Supported OS: Windows, Mac, and Linux
[*] UNLOCKED - Partial Japanese Voice Acting!
[*] UNLOCKED - Animated CGs + more CG scenes!
[*] UNLOCKED - A hot spring trip (with plenty of fan service, of course)!
[*] UNLOCKED - A yuri scene plus even more story and CGs!
[/list]
So what are you waiting for? Jump in on the ecchi action before time runs out!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mikandijapan/gremory-tale-of-the-god-slayer-adult-vn-bullethell?ref=6vqdo9][h1]Pledge on "Gremory" HERE![/h1][/url]

notes.title: Patreon Highlights; Pledge $10, Get Our New Visual Novel!
notes.content:
Hello Steam Family,

Have you been following us on Patreon? Following us is FREE! You'll get an email notification of our public posts which you can read, "like", and leave comments on. Here's the highlights from [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/help-us-decide-e-19832494]this week's update[/url] in case you missed it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33076600/3c3ed04099664a5d2c941b2b96e34dfcdc9c59f6.png[/img]

[olist]
    [*]HELP us decide what to do with July's (giveaway) items!
    [*]E-GENE's NobuNYAga collectible art card revealed!
    [*]LIBRA's vampire slayer, Aoi Kamishiro re-imagined in this fan art!
    [*]NEW Gachapon arriving!
[/olist]

[h1]Get the Game, Wallpapers, and More for 10 Bucks![/h1]
By the way... if you support us for one month on Patreon at the [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/MiKandiJapan]$10 ONCE BITTEN[/url][/b] reward tier, you'll get the following:
[list]
[*]Patreon-only community voting!  
[*]Access to our private newsfeed posts and pics!  
[*][b]Shout out:[/b] In honor of Libra's script update, patrons will have their name/nickname added in a shout out on Libra's official EN site, Kickstarter, and Steam pages!  
[*][b][h1]*NEW* E-Gene 1st Game Steam Key. This is the visual novel series we are developing with Japanese game maker Laplacian (known for Newton and the Apple Tree)![/h1][/b]
[*][b][h1]*NEW* Hi-Res images from Akihabara you can use as desktop and mobile wallpapers![/h1][/b]  
[/list]

We appreciate any support you could give to help move us closer to our furry goals of creating E-Gene and improving Libra! Arigatougozaimasu~ ^_^

Onward to Victory,

MiKandi Japan
